about: check_result, whose nullable members are a type array holding array plus null (the dialect admits array here; see the README).

instance.description: The result of a check: whether it passed, the sentence to show when it did not, and the lists or counts the operation gives.

message.description: The failWith sentence when the check did not pass; null when it passed.

uncovered.description: terms_subset only: the terms not found in the text; null from the aggregates.

untested.description: terms_subset only: the terms that could not be tested; null from the aggregates.

passed.description: The aggregates' count of results that passed; null from terms_subset.

total.description: The aggregates' count of results judged; null from terms_subset.
